milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate near the yellow stained glass panes on the west wall of the building (spawn-relative center at [3, 1, 6]) and face toward them. max_distance=16 allows detection from a reasonable viewing distance, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at the panes.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate near the iron door on the south wall of the building (spawn-relative at [5, 0, 3]) and face toward it. max_distance=16 allows detection from a reasonable viewing distance, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking at the door.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate near the acacia button next to the iron door (spawn-relative at [6, 1, 3]) and face toward it. max_distance=8 is used (tighter than default) because the button is a small block that requires closer proximity to identify, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking at it.

Uses inventory_has because mining an acacia door causes it to drop as an item that enters the player's inventory. The player must break the acacia door block inside the building (behind the iron door) and pick up the dropped item. This is the preferred rule type for mine tasks.
